verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֖א אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו מֵאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’el- mō·šeh way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’ê·lāw mê·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting saying
verses.literalPt: Chamou Jeová a Moisés e disse-lhe da tenda da revelação:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אָדָ֗ם כִּֽי־ יַקְרִ֥יב מִכֶּ֛ם קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה מִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֗ה מִן־ הַבָּקָר֙ וּמִן־ הַצֹּ֔אן תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ אֶת־ קָרְבַּנְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’ā·ḏām kî- yaq·rîḇ mik·kem qār·bān Yah·weh min- hab·bə·hê·māh min- hab·bā·qār ū·min- haṣ·ṣōn taq·rî·ḇū ’eṯ- qā·rə·ban·ḵem
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them When any of you brings an offering to the LORD you may bring as your offering an animal from the herd . . . or the flock
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel e dize-lhes: Quando algum de vós oferecer uma oblação a Jeová, do gado, isto é, do gado vacum ou gado miúdo, oferecereis as vossas oblações.

verses.original: אִם־ עֹלָ֤ה קָרְבָּנוֹ֙ מִן־ הַבָּקָ֔ר זָכָ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶ֑נּוּ אֶל־ פֶּ֝תַח אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ יַקְרִ֣יב אֹת֔וֹ לִרְצֹנ֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ‘ō·lāh qā·rə·bā·nōw min- hab·bā·qār zā·ḵār tā·mîm yaq·rî·ḇen·nū ’el- pɛ·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ yaq·rîḇ ’ō·ṯōw lir·ṣō·nōw lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd he is to present an unblemished male He must bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for its acceptance before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Se a sua oblação for holocausto tirado do gado vacum, oferecerá ele um macho sem defeito; oferecê-lo-á à porta da tenda da revelação, para que seja aceito diante de Jeová.

verses.original: וְסָמַ֣ךְ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הָעֹלָ֑ה וְנִרְצָ֥ה ל֖וֹ לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·maḵ yā·ḏōw ‘al rōš hā·‘ō·lāh wə·nir·ṣāh lōw lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: He is to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering so it can be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him
verses.literalPt: Porá a mão sobre a cabeça do holocausto; e este será aceito a favor dele para lhe servir de expiação.

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת־ בֶּ֥ן הַבָּקָ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֠הִקְרִיבוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן הַֽכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֶת־ הַדָּ֔ם וְזָרְק֨וּ אֶת־ הַדָּ֤ם עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- ben hab·bā·qār lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·hiq·rî·ḇū bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hă·nîm ’eṯ- had·dām wə·zā·rə·qū ’eṯ- had·dām ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ sā·ḇîḇ ’ă·šer- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: And he shall slaughter the young bull before the LORD and Aaron’s sons the priests are to present the blood and splatter it on all sides of the altar at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Ele matará o novilho diante de Jeová: os filhos de Arão, os sacerdotes, oferecerão o sangue, e o aspergirão ao redor sobre o altar que está à porta da tenda da revelação.

verses.original: וְהִפְשִׁ֖יט אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֑ה וְנִתַּ֥ח אֹתָ֖הּ לִנְתָחֶֽיהָ׃
verses.literal: Next, he is to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces
verses.literalPt: Então ele esfolará o holocausto e o cortará em pedaços.

verses.original: וְ֠נָתְנוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֵ֖שׁ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעָרְכ֥וּ עֵצִ֖ים עַל־ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯə·nū bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên ’êš ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·‘ā·rə·ḵū ‘ê·ṣîm ‘al- hā·’êš
verses.literal: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put a fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Arão, o sacerdote, porão fogo sobre o altar e colocarão em ordem lenha sobre o fogo.

verses.original: וְעָרְכ֗וּ בְּנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אֵ֚ת הַנְּתָחִ֔ים אֶת־ הָרֹ֖אשׁ וְאֶת־ הַפָּ֑דֶר עַל־ הָעֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·rə·ḵū bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hă·nîm ’êṯ han·nə·ṯā·ḥîm ’eṯ- hā·rōš wə·’eṯ- hap·pā·ḏer ‘al- hā·‘ê·ṣîm ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·’êš ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then Aaron’s sons the priests are to arrange the pieces including the head and the fat atop the burning - wood on the altar
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Arão, os sacerdotes, colocarão em ordem os pedaços, a saber, a cabeça e a gordura, sobre a lenha que está no fogo em cima do altar;

verses.original: וְקִרְבּ֥וֹ וּכְרָעָ֖יו יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־ הַכֹּל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־ נִיח֖וֹחַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·qir·bōw ū·ḵə·rā·‘āw yir·ḥaṣ bam·mā·yim wə·hiq·ṭîr hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hak·kōl ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ‘ō·lāh ’iš·šêh rê·aḥ- nî·ḥō·w·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The entrails and legs must be washed with water and the priest shall burn all of it on the altar as a burnt offering a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: mas os intestinos e as pernas do novilho ele os lavará com água. O sacerdote queimará tudo isso sobre o altar como holocausto, oferta queimada, de suave cheiro a Jeová.

verses.original: וְאִם־ מִן־ הַצֹּ֨אן קָרְבָּנ֧וֹ מִן־ הַכְּשָׂבִ֛ים א֥וֹ מִן־ הָעִזִּ֖ים לְעֹלָ֑ה זָכָ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- min- haṣ·ṣōn qā·rə·bā·nōw min- hak·kə·śā·ḇîm ’ōw min- hā·‘iz·zîm lə·‘ō·lāh zā·ḵār tā·mîm yaq·rî·ḇen·nū
verses.literal: If, however one’s offering is a burnt offering from the flock from the sheep or . . . goats he is to present an unblemished male
verses.literalPt: Se a sua oblação em holocausto for do gado miúdo, das ovelhas ou das cabras, oferecerá ele um macho sem defeito.

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֨ט אֹת֜וֹ עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ צָפֹ֖נָה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְזָרְק֡וּ בְּנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים אֶת־ דָּמ֛וֹ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’ō·ṯōw ‘al ye·reḵ ham·miz·bê·aḥ ṣā·p̄ō·nāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·zā·rə·qū bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hă·nîm ’eṯ- dā·mōw ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: He shall slaughter it on the north side of the altar before the LORD and Aaron’s sons the priests are to splatter its blood against the altar on all sides
verses.literalPt: Matá-lo-á diante de Jeová ao lado do altar que olha para o norte, e os filhos de Arão, os sacerdotes, aspergirão o sangue sobre o altar em redor.

verses.original: וְנִתַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ לִנְתָחָ֔יו וְאֶת־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ פִּדְר֑וֹ וְעָרַ֤ךְ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔ם עַל־ הָֽעֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nit·taḥ ’ō·ṯōw lin·ṯā·ḥāw wə·’eṯ- rō·šōw wə·’eṯ- piḏ·rōw wə·‘ā·raḵ hak·kō·hên ’ō·ṯām ‘al- hā·‘ê·ṣîm ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·’êš ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: He is to cut the animal into pieces and the priest shall arrange them including the head and fat atop the burning - wood that is on the altar
verses.literalPt: Então ele o cortará em pedaços; e, juntamente com a cabeça e a gordura, o sacerdote os porá em ordem sobre a lenha que está no fogo em cima do altar;

verses.original: וְהַקֶּ֥רֶב וְהַכְּרָעַ֖יִם יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְהִקְרִ֨יב הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־ הַכֹּל֙ וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֣ה ה֗וּא אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·haq·qe·reḇ wə·hak·kə·rā·‘a·yim yir·ḥaṣ bam·mā·yim wə·hiq·rîḇ hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hak·kōl wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ‘ō·lāh hū ’iš·šêh rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The entrails and legs must be washed with water and the priest shall present all of it and burn it on the altar it is a burnt offering a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: mas os intestinos e as pernas ele os lavará com água. O sacerdote oferecerá tudo isso e o queimará sobre o altar; holocausto é, oferta queimada, de suave cheiro a Jeová.

verses.original: וְאִ֧ם מִן־ הָע֛וֹף עֹלָ֥ה קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהִקְרִ֣יב מִן־ הַתֹּרִ֗ים א֛וֹ מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י הַיּוֹנָ֖ה אֶת־ קָרְבָּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im min- hā·‘ō·wp̄ ‘ō·lāh qā·rə·bā·nōw Yah·weh wə·hiq·rîḇ min- hat·tō·rîm ’ōw min- bə·nê hay·yō·w·nāh ’eṯ- qā·rə·bā·nōw
verses.literal: If, instead one’s offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds he is to present . . . . . . a turtledove or . . . a young pigeon
verses.literalPt: Se a sua oblação a Jeová for holocausto tirado das aves, a sua oblação que oferecerá será de rolas ou de pombinhos.

verses.original: וְהִקְרִיב֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וּמָלַק֙ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְנִמְצָ֣ה דָמ֔וֹ עַ֖ל קִ֥יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rî·ḇōw hak·kō·hên ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ū·mā·laq ’eṯ- rō·šōw wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh wə·nim·ṣāh ḏā·mōw ‘al qîr ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then the priest shall bring it to the altar twist off its head and burn it on the altar its blood should be drained out on the side of the altar
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote a trará ao altar, e lhe destroncará o pescoço, e a queimará sobre o altar. O sangue dela ele fará correr sobre a borda do altar,

verses.original: וְהֵסִ֥יר אֶת־ מֻרְאָת֖וֹ בְּנֹצָתָ֑הּ וְהִשְׁלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜הּ אֵ֤צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ קֵ֔דְמָה אֶל־ מְק֖וֹם הַדָּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·sîr ’eṯ- mur·’ā·ṯōw bə·nō·ṣā·ṯāh wə·hiš·lîḵ ’ō·ṯāh ’ê·ṣel ham·miz·bê·aḥ qê·ḏə·māh ’el- mə·qō·wm had·dā·šen
verses.literal: And he is to remove the crop with its contents and throw it to the east side of the altar in the place for ashes
verses.literalPt: tirará o papo e seu excremento e o lançará junto ao altar para o lado do oriente, no lugar da cinza.

verses.original: וְשִׁסַּ֨ע אֹת֣וֹ בִכְנָפָיו֮ לֹ֣א יַבְדִּיל֒ וְהִקְטִ֨יר אֹת֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַל־ הָעֵצִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הָאֵ֑שׁ עֹלָ֣ה ה֗וּא אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šis·sa‘ ’ō·ṯōw ḇiḵ·nā·p̄āw lō yaḇ·dîl wə·hiq·ṭîr ’ō·ṯōw hak·kō·hên ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ‘al- hā·‘ê·ṣîm ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·’êš ‘ō·lāh hū ’iš·šêh rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: He shall tear it open by its wings without dividing the bird completely And the priest is to burn it on the altar atop the burning wood - It is a burnt offering a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Fendê-la-á perto das asas, porém não a partirá; o sacerdote a queimará sobre o altar, em cima da lenha que está no fogo; holocausto é, oferta queimada, de suave cheiro a Jeová.
